# degit

> degit is a command-line tool for copying git repositories. It downloads a tarball snapshot of the latest commit (or a specified ref) instead of cloning the full git history, which makes it faster than `git clone --depth 1` for scaffolding projects from templates.

Important notes:

- degit supports GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Sourcehut; private repositories are handled automatically with SSH fallback.
- Public HTTPS sources do not need a local `git` binary, but SSH/private sources still require one.
- Post-download transformations can be declared in a top-level `degit.json` file using `clone`, `search_replace`, and `remove` actions.
- Development of this repository requires Bun 1.3.14; end users can install the published package with npm.

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rich-Harris/degit/master/README.md): Overview, installation, usage examples, ESM API, and actions reference.
- [assets/help.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rich-Harris/degit/master/assets/help.md): CLI help text covering source formats, refs, options, aliases, and `degit.json` actions.
- [docs/CHANGELOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rich-Harris/degit/master/docs/CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes.

- [docs/CONTRIBUTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rich-Harris/degit/master/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md): Bug reports, enhancement suggestions, style guides, and commit conventions.

## Agent skill

- [skills/degit/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rich-Harris/degit/master/skills/degit/SKILL.md): Reusable agent skill for scaffolding projects with `degit`.

## Implementation

- [src/bin.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rich-Harris/degit/master/src/bin.ts): CLI entry point, argument parsing, and command dispatch.
- [src/index.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rich-Harris/degit/master/src/index.ts): Public API and main `degit` function.
- [src/core/orchestrator.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rich-Harris/degit/master/src/core/orchestrator.ts): Core download, cache, extraction, and fallback logic.
- [src/shared/utils.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rich-Harris/degit/master/src/shared/utils.ts): Shared utilities used across the project.

## Tests

- [test/unit](https://github.com/Rich-Harris/degit/tree/master/test/unit): Unit tests.
- [test/integration](https://github.com/Rich-Harris/degit/tree/master/test/integration): Public and private integration tests; run with `bun run test` or `bun run test:integration`.
